h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bihar

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bihar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bihar

c: FunPlay Systems makes outdoor gym equipment for parks, schools, colleges and housing societies in Bihar. Every Fun Fitness machine is built at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, which has been running since 2002. We send the equipment to Bihar by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region sets it up on your ground. Our factory has 150+ employees covering design, fabrication and quality inspection.

We supply all parts of the state, from Patna and the towns along the Ganga to Gaya, Sasaram, Dehri, Buxar and Arrah in the south and west. Town parks and school grounds are the most common sites. Many towns also have young people training every morning for police and defence recruitment tests, and a few pull-up and parallel bar stations in a public ground get used every day. Housing societies in Patna, on the other hand, usually want gentler machines for residents of all ages.

richText.heading: Machines and bases for Bihar's summers and winters

c: Bihar summers are hot, with dry winds in May and June, and winter mornings are cold and foggy. Plan the gym where trees or a shed give shade in the afternoon, since metal handles get hot in direct sun. North Bihar floods in the monsoon, so a raised, grouted base works better there than bare soil.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines suit young people training for physical tests?
items.a: The Pull Up Station, Parallel Bar and Leg Press are good for strength work, and they take heavy daily use. We can place them next to an existing running track so training stays in one area.

items.q: Can you install outdoor gym equipment in smaller towns in Bihar?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai to any town in the state. Our team or a dealer near you installs the stations, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

items.q: What warranty comes with your outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the machines are installed and maintained as we advise.
